1.zh: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言：
1.en: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

1.zh: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲， 分辨通达的言语，
1.en: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

1.zh: 使人处事领受智慧、 仁义、公平、正直的训诲，
1.en: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

1.zh: 使愚人灵明， 使少年人有知识和谋略，
1.en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

1.zh: 使智慧人听见，增长学问， 使聪明人得着智谋，
1.en: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

1.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻， 懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。
1.en: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

1.zh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端； 愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。
1.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

1.zh: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲， 不可离弃你母亲的法则；
1.en: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

1.zh: 因为这要作你头上的华冠， 你项上的[金]链。
1.en: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

1.zh: 我儿，恶人若引诱你， 你不可随从。
1.en: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

1.zh: 他们若说：你与我们同去， 我们要埋伏流人之血， 要蹲伏害无罪之人；
1.en: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

1.zh: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下； 他们如同下坑的人， 被我们囫囵吞了；
1.en: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

1.zh: 我们必得各样宝物， 将所掳来的，装满房屋；
1.en: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

1.zh: 你与我们大家同分， 我们共用一个囊袋；
1.en: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

1.zh: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道， 禁止你脚走他们的路。
1.en: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

1.zh: 因为，他们的脚奔跑行恶； 他们急速流人的血，
1.en: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

1.zh: 好像飞鸟， 网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。
1.en: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

1.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血； 蹲伏，是为自害己命。
1.en: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

1.zh: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路都是如此； 这贪恋之心乃夺去得财者之命。
1.en: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

1.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊， 在宽阔处发声，
1.en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

1.zh: 在热闹街头喊叫， 在城门口，在城中发出言语，
1.en: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

1.zh: 说：你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧， 亵慢人喜欢亵慢， 愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？
1.en: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

1.zh: 你们当因我的责备回转； 我要将我的灵浇灌你们， 将我的话指示你们。
1.en: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

1.zh: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从； 我伸手，无人理会；
1.en: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

1.zh: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒， 不肯受我的责备。
1.en: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

1.zh: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑； 惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。
1.en: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

1.zh: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风； 灾难来到，如同暴风； 急难痛苦临到你们身上。
1.en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

1.zh: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应， 恳切地寻找我，却寻不见。
1.en: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

1.zh: 因为，你们恨恶知识， 不喜爱敬畏耶和华，
1.en: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

1.zh: 不听我的劝戒， 藐视我一切的责备，
1.en: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

1.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子， 充满自设的计谋。
1.en: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

1.zh: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身； 愚顽人安逸，必害己命。
1.en: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

1.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住， 得享安静，不怕灾祸。
1.en: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

2.zh: 我儿，你若领受我的言语， 存记我的命令，
2.en: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

2.zh: 侧耳听智慧， 专心求聪明，
2.en: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

2.zh: 呼求明哲， 扬声求聪明，
2.en: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

2.zh: 寻找它，如寻找银子， 搜求它，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，
2.en: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

2.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和华， 得以认识　神。
2.en: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

2.zh: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧； 知识和聪明都由他口而出。
2.en: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

2.zh: 他给正直人存留真智慧， 给行为纯正的人作盾牌，
2.en: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

2.zh: 为要保守公平人的路， 护庇虔敬人的道。
2.en: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

2.zh: 你也必明白仁义、公平、 正直、一切的善道。
2.en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

2.zh: 智慧必入你心； 你的灵要以知识为美。
2.en: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

2.zh: 谋略必护卫你； 聪明必保守你，
2.en: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

2.zh: 要救你脱离恶道， 脱离说乖谬话的人。
2.en: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

2.zh: 那等人舍弃正直的路， 行走黑暗的道，
2.en: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

2.zh: 欢喜作恶， 喜爱恶[人]的乖僻，
2.en: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

2.zh: 在他们的道中弯曲， 在他们的路上偏僻。
2.en: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

2.zh: 智[慧]要救你脱离淫妇， 就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
2.en: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

2.zh: 她离弃幼年的配偶， 忘了　神的盟约。
2.en: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

2.zh: 她的家陷入死地； 她的路偏向阴间。
2.en: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

2.zh: 凡到她那里去的，不得转回， 也得不着生命的路。
2.en: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

2.zh: [智慧]必使你行善人的道， 守义人的路。
2.en: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

2.zh: 正直人必在世上居住； 完全人必在地上存留。
2.en: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

2.zh: 惟有恶人必然剪除； 奸诈的，必然拔出。
2.en: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

3.zh: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则； 你心要谨守我的诫命；
3.en: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

3.zh: 因为它必将长久的日子， 生命的年数与平安，加给你。
3.en: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

3.zh: 不可使慈爱、诚实离开你， 要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。
3.en: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

3.zh: 这样，你必在　神和世人眼前 蒙恩宠，有聪明。
3.en: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

3.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华， 不可倚靠自己的聪明，
3.en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

3.zh: 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他， 他必指引你的路。
3.en: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

3.zh: 不要自以为有智慧； 要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。
3.en: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

3.zh: 这便医治你的肚脐， 滋润你的百骨。
3.en: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

3.zh: 你要以财物 和一切初熟的土产尊荣耶和华。
3.en: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

3.zh: 这样，你的仓房必充满有余； 你的酒榨有新酒盈溢。
3.en: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

3.zh: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教， 也不可厌烦他的责备；
3.en: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

3.zh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备， 正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。
3.en: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

3.zh: 得智慧，得聪明的， 这人便为有福。
3.en: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

3.zh: 因为得智慧胜过得银子， 其利益强如精金，
3.en: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

3.zh: 比珍珠宝贵； 你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。
3.en: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

3.zh: 她右手有长寿， 左手有富贵。
3.en: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

3.zh: 她的道是安乐； 她的路全是平安。
3.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

3.zh: 她与持守她的作生命树； 持定她的，俱各有福。
3.en: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

3.zh: 耶和华以智慧立地， 以聪明定天，
3.en: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

3.zh: 以知识使深渊裂开， 使天空滴下甘露。
3.en: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

3.zh: 我儿，要谨守真智慧和谋略， 不可使她离开你的眼目。
3.en: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

3.zh: 这样，她必作你的生命， 颈项的美饰。
3.en: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

3.zh: 你就坦然行路， 不致碰脚。
3.en: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

3.zh: 你躺下，必不惧怕； 你躺卧，睡得香甜。
3.en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

3.zh: 忽然来的惊恐，不要害怕； 恶人遭毁灭，也不要恐惧。
3.en: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

3.zh: 因为耶和华是你所倚靠的； 他必保守你的脚不陷入网罗。
3.en: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

3.zh: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辞， 就当向那应得的人施行。
3.en: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

3.zh: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说： 去吧，明天再来，我必给你。
3.en: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

3.zh: 你的邻舍既在你附近安居， 你不可设计害他。
3.en: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

3.zh: 人未曾加害与你， 不可无故与他相争。
3.en: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

3.zh: 不可嫉妒强暴的人， 也不可选择他所行的路。
3.en: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

3.zh: 因为，乖僻人为耶和华所憎恶； 正直人为他所亲密。
3.en: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

3.zh: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家庭， 赐福与义人的居所。
3.en: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

3.zh: 他讥诮那好讥诮的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。
3.en: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

3.zh: 智慧人必承受尊荣； 愚昧人高升也成为羞辱。
3.en: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

4.zh: 众子啊，要听父亲的教训， 留心得知聪明。
4.en: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

4.zh: 因我所给你们的是好教训； 不可离弃我的法则。
4.en: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

4.zh: 我在父亲面前为孝子， 在母亲眼中为独一的娇儿。
4.en: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

4.zh: 父亲教训我说：你心要存记我的言语， 遵守我的命令，便得存活。
4.en: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

4.zh: 要得智慧，要得聪明，不可忘记， 也不可偏离我口中的言语。
4.en: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

4.zh: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就护卫你； 要爱她，她就保守你。
4.en: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

4.zh: 智慧为首； [所以]，要得智慧。 在你一切所得之内必得聪明 。
4.en: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

4.zh: 高举智慧，她就使你高升； 怀抱智慧，她就使你尊荣。
4.en: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

4.zh: 她必将华冠加在你头上， 把荣冕交给你。
4.en: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

4.zh: 我儿，你要听受我的言语， 就必延年益寿。
4.en: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

4.zh: 我已指教你走智慧的道， 引导你行正直的路。
4.en: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

4.zh: 你行走，脚步必不致狭窄； 你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
4.en: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

4.zh: 要持定训诲，不可放松； 必当谨守，因为它是你的生命。
4.en: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

4.zh: 不可行恶人的路； 不要走坏人的道。
4.en: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

4.zh: 要躲避，不可经过； 要转身而去。
4.en: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

4.zh: 这等人若不行恶，不得睡觉； 不使人跌倒，睡卧不安；
4.en: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

4.zh: 因为他们以奸恶吃饼， 以强暴喝酒。
4.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

4.zh: 但义人的路好像黎明的光， 越照越明，直到日午。
4.en: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

4.zh: 恶人的道好像幽暗， 自己不知因什么跌倒。
4.en: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

4.zh: 我儿，要留心听我的言词， 侧耳听我的话语，
4.en: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

4.zh: 都不可离你的眼目， 要存记在你心中。
4.en: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

4.zh: 因为得着它的，就得了生命， 又得了医全体的良药。
4.en: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

4.zh: 你要保守你心，胜过保守一切， 因为一生的果效是由心发出。
4.en: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

4.zh: 你要除掉邪僻的口， 弃绝乖谬的嘴。
4.en: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

4.zh: 你的眼目要向前正看； 你的眼睛当向前直观。
4.en: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

4.zh: 要修平你脚下的路， 坚定你一切的道。
4.en: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

4.zh: 不可偏向左右； 要使你的脚离开邪恶。
4.en: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

5.zh: 我儿，要留心我智慧的话语， 侧耳听我聪明的言词，
5.en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

5.zh: 为要使你谨守谋略， 嘴唇保存知识。
5.en: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

5.zh: 因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜； 她的口比油更滑，
5.en: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

5.zh: 至终却苦似茵 ， 快如两刃的刀。
5.en: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

5.zh: 她的脚下入死地； 她脚步踏住阴间，
5.en: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

5.zh: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。 她的路变迁不定， 自己还不知道。
5.en: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

5.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我； 不可离弃我口中的话。
5.en: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

5.zh: 你所行的道要离她远， 不可就近她的房门，
5.en: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

5.zh: 恐怕将你的尊荣给别人， 将你的岁月给残忍的人；
5.en: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

5.zh: 恐怕外人满得你的力量， 你劳碌得来的，归入外人的家；
5.en: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

5.zh: 终久，你皮肉和身体消毁， 你就悲叹，
5.en: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

5.zh: 说：我怎么恨恶训诲， 心中藐视责备，
5.en: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

5.zh: 也不听从我师傅的话， 又不侧耳听那教训我的人？
5.en: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

5.zh: 我在[圣]会里， 几乎落在诸般恶中。
5.en: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

5.zh: 你要喝自己池中的水， 饮自己井里的活水。
5.en: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

5.zh: 你的泉源岂可涨溢在外？ 你的河水岂可流在街上？
5.en: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

5.zh: 惟独归你一人， 不可与外人同用。
5.en: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

5.zh: 要使你的泉源蒙福； 要喜悦你幼年所娶的妻。
5.en: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

5.zh: 她如可爱的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿； 愿她的胸怀使你时时知足， 她的爱情使你常常恋慕。
5.en: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

5.zh: 我儿，你为何恋慕淫妇？ 为何抱外女的胸怀？
5.en: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

5.zh: 因为，人所行的道都在耶和华眼前； 他也修平人一切的路。
5.en: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

5.zh: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住； 他必被自己的罪恶如绳索缠绕。
5.en: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

5.zh: 他因不受训诲就必死亡； 又因愚昧过甚，必走差了路。
5.en: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

6.zh: 我儿，你若为朋友作保， 替外人击掌，
6.en: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

6.zh: 你就被口中的话语缠住， 被嘴里的言语捉住。
6.en: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

6.zh: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中， 就当这样行才可救自己： 你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。
6.en: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

6.zh: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉； 不要容你的眼皮打盹。
6.en: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

6.zh: 要救自己，如鹿脱离[猎户的]手， 如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。
6.en: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

6.zh: 懒惰人哪， 你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。
6.en: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

6.zh: 蚂蚁没有元帅， 没有官长，没有君王，
6.en: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

6.zh: 尚且在夏天预备食物， 在收割时聚敛粮食。
6.en: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

6.zh: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？ 你何时睡醒呢？
6.en: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

6.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时， 抱着手躺卧片时，
6.en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

6.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来， 你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。
6.en: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

6.zh: 无赖的恶徒， 行动就用乖僻的口，
6.en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

6.zh: 用眼传神， 用脚示意， 用指点划，
6.en: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

6.zh: 心中乖僻， 常设恶谋， 布散纷争。
6.en: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

6.zh: 所以，灾难必忽然临到他身； 他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
6.en: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

6.zh: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样， 连他心所憎恶的共有七样：
6.en: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

6.zh: 就是高傲的眼， 撒谎的舌， 流无辜人血的手，
6.en: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

6.zh: 图谋恶计的心， 飞跑行恶的脚，
6.en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

6.zh: 吐谎言的假见证， 并弟兄中布散纷争的人。
6.en: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

6.zh: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命； 不可离弃你母亲的法则，
6.en: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

6.zh: 要常系在你心上， 挂在你项上。
6.en: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

6.zh: 你行走，它必引导你； 你躺卧，它必保守你； 你睡醒，它必与你谈论。
6.en: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

6.zh: 因为诫命是灯，法则是光， 训诲的责备是生命的道，
6.en: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

6.zh: 能保你远离恶妇， 远离外女谄媚的舌头。
6.en: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

6.zh: 你心中不要恋慕她的美色， 也不要被她眼皮勾引。
6.en: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

6.zh: 因为，妓女[能使人]只剩一块饼； 淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。
6.en: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

6.zh: 人若怀里搋火， 衣服岂能不烧呢？
6.en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

6.zh: 人若在火炭上走， 脚岂能不烫呢？
6.en: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

6.zh: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此； 凡挨近她的，不免受罚。
6.en: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

6.zh: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥， 人不藐视他，
6.en: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

6.zh: 若被找着，他必赔还七倍， 必将家中所有的尽都偿还。
6.en: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

6.zh: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知； 行这事的，必丧掉生命。
6.en: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

6.zh: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱； 他的羞耻不得涂抹。
6.en: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

6.zh: 因为人的嫉恨成了烈怒， 报仇的时候决不留情。
6.en: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

6.zh: 什么赎价，他都不顾； 你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。
6.en: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

7.zh: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语， 将我的命令存记在心。
7.en: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

7.zh: 遵守我的命令就得存活； 保守我的法则， 好像保守眼中的瞳人，
7.en: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

7.zh: 系在你指头上， 刻在你心版上。
7.en: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

7.zh: 对智慧说：你是我的姊妹， 称呼聪明为你的亲人，
7.en: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

7.zh: 她就保你远离淫妇， 远离说谄媚话的外女。
7.en: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

7.zh: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内， 从我窗棂之间往外观看：
7.en: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

7.zh: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中， 分明有一个无知的少年人，
7.en: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

7.zh: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口， 直往通她家的路去，
7.en: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

7.zh: 在黄昏，或晚上， 或半夜，或黑暗之中。
7.en: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

7.zh: 看哪，有一个妇人来迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，有诡诈的心思。
7.en: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

7.zh: 这妇人喧嚷，不守约束， 在家里停不住脚，
7.en: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

7.zh: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处， 或在各巷口蹲伏，
7.en: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

7.zh: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴， 脸无羞耻对他说：
7.en: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

7.zh: 平安祭在我这里， 今日才还了我所许的愿。
7.en: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

7.zh: 因此，我出来迎接你， 恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。
7.en: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

7.zh: 我已经用绣花毯子 和埃及线织的花纹布铺了我的床。
7.en: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

7.zh: 我又用没药、沉香、桂皮 薰了我的榻。
7.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

7.zh: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨； 我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。
7.en: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

7.zh: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路；
7.en: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

7.zh: 他手拿银囊，必到月望才回家。
7.en: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

7.zh: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从， 用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。
7.en: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

7.zh: 少年人立刻跟随她，好像牛往宰杀之地； 又像愚昧人带锁链去受刑罚，
7.en: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

7.zh: 直等箭穿他的肝； 如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。
7.en: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

7.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我， 留心听我口中的话。
7.en: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

7.zh: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道， 不要入她的迷途。
7.en: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

7.zh: 因为，被她伤害仆倒的不少； 被她杀戮的而且甚多。
7.en: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

7.zh: 她的家是在阴间之路， 下到死亡之宫。
7.en: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

8.zh: 智慧岂不呼叫？ 聪明岂不发声？
8.en: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

8.zh: 她在道旁高处的顶上， 在十字路口站立，
8.en: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

8.zh: 在城门旁，在城门口， 在城门洞，大声说：
8.en: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

8.zh: 众人哪，我呼叫你们， 我向世人发声。
8.en: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

8.zh: 说：愚蒙人哪，你们要会悟灵明； 愚昧人哪，你们当心里明白。
8.en: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

8.zh: 你们当听，因我要说极美的话； 我张嘴要论正直的事。
8.en: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

8.zh: 我的口要发出真理； 我的嘴憎恶邪恶。
8.en: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

8.zh: 我口中的言语都是公义， 并无弯曲乖僻。
8.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

8.zh: 有聪明的，以为明显， 得知识的，以为正直。
8.en: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

8.zh: 你们当受我的教训，不受白银； 宁得知识，胜过黄金。
8.en: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

8.zh: 因为智慧比珍珠更美； 一切可喜爱的都不足与比较。
8.en: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

8.zh: 我—智慧以灵明为居所， 又寻得知识和谋略。
8.en: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

8.zh: 敬畏耶和华在乎恨恶邪恶； 那骄傲、狂妄，并恶道， 以及乖谬的口，都为我所恨恶。
8.en: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

8.zh: 我有谋略和真知识； 我乃聪明，我有能力。
8.en: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

8.zh: 帝王借我坐国位； 君王借我定公平。
8.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

8.zh: 王子和首领， 世上一切的审判官，都是借我掌权。
8.en: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

8.zh: 爱我的，我也爱他； 恳切寻求我的，必寻得见。
8.en: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

8.zh: 丰富尊荣在我； 恒久的财并公义也在我。
8.en: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

8.zh: 我的果实胜过黄金，强如精金； 我的出产超乎高银。
8.en: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

8.zh: 我在公义的道上走， 在公平的路中行，
8.en: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

8.zh: 使爱我的，承受货财， 并充满他们的府库。
8.en: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

8.zh: 在耶和华造化的起头， 在太初创造万物之先，就有了我。
8.en: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

8.zh: 从亘古，从太初， 未有世界以前，我已被立。
8.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

8.zh: 没有深渊， 没有大水的泉源，我已生出。
8.en: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

8.zh: 大山未曾奠定， 小山未有之先，我已生出。
8.en: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

8.zh: 耶和华还没有创造大地和田野， 并世上的土质，我已生出。
8.en: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

8.zh: 他立高天，我在那里； 他在渊面的周围，划出圆圈。
8.en: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

8.zh: 上使穹苍坚硬， 下使渊源稳固，
8.en: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

8.zh: 为沧海定出界限，使水不越过他的命令， 立定大地的根基。
8.en: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

8.zh: 那时，我在他那里为工师， 日日为他所喜爱， 常常在他面前踊跃，
8.en: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

8.zh: 踊跃在他为人[预备]可住之地， 也喜悦住在世人之间。
8.en: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

8.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我， 因为谨守我道的，便为有福。
8.en: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

8.zh: 要听教训就得智慧， 不可弃绝。
8.en: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

8.zh: 听从我、日日在我门口仰望、 在我门框旁边等候的，那人便为有福。
8.en: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

8.zh: 因为寻得我的，就寻得生命， 也必蒙耶和华的恩惠。
8.en: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

8.zh: 得罪我的，却害了自己的性命； 恨恶我的，都喜爱死亡。
8.en: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

9.zh: 智慧建造房屋， 凿成七根柱子，
9.en: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

9.zh: 宰杀牲畜， 调和旨酒， 设摆筵席；
9.en: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

9.zh: 打发使女出去， 自己在城中至高处呼叫，
9.en: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

9.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！ 又对那无知的人说：
9.en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

9.zh: 你们来，吃我的饼， 喝我调和的酒。
9.en: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

9.zh: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃[愚蒙]， 就得存活，并要走光明的道。
9.en: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

9.zh: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂； 责备恶人的，必被玷污。
9.en: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

9.zh: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你； 要责备智慧人，他必爱你。
9.en: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

9.zh: [教导]智慧人，他就越发有智慧； 指示义人，他就增长学问。
9.en: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

9.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 认识至圣者便是聪明。
9.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

9.zh: 你借着我，日子必增多， 年岁也必加添。
9.en: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

9.zh: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益； 你若亵慢，就必独自担当。
9.en: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

9.zh: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷； 她是愚蒙，一无所知。
9.en: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

9.zh: 她坐在自己的家门口， 坐在城中高处的座位上，
9.en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

9.zh: 呼叫过路的， 就是直行其道的人，
9.en: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

9.zh: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！ 又对那无知的人说：
9.en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

9.zh: 偷来的水是甜的， 暗[吃的]饼是好的。
9.en: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

9.zh: 人却不知有阴魂在她那里； 她的客在阴间的深处。
9.en: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

10.zh: 所罗门的箴言： 智慧之子使父亲欢乐； 愚昧之子叫母亲担忧。
10.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

10.zh: 不义之财毫无益处； 惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
10.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

10.zh: 耶和华不使义人受饥饿； 恶人所欲的，他必推开。
10.en: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

10.zh: 手懒的，要受贫穷； 手勤的，却要富足。
10.en: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

10.zh: 夏天聚敛的，是智慧之子； 收割时沉睡的，是贻羞之子。
10.en: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

10.zh: 福祉临到义人的头； 强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
10.en: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

10.zh: 义人的纪念被称赞； 恶人的名字必朽烂。
10.en: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

10.zh: 心中智慧的，必受命令； 口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
10.en: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

10.zh: 行正直路的，步步安稳； 走弯曲道的，必致败露。
10.en: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

10.zh: 以眼传神的，使人忧患； 口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。
10.en: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

10.zh: 义人的口是生命的泉源； 强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。
10.en: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

10.zh: 恨能挑启争端； 爱能遮掩一切过错。
10.en: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

10.zh: 明哲人嘴里有智慧； 无知人背上受刑杖。
10.en: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

10.zh: 智慧人积存知识； 愚妄人的口速致败坏。
10.en: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

10.zh: 富户的财物是他的坚城； 穷人的贫乏是他的败坏。
10.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

10.zh: 义人的勤劳致生； 恶人的进项致死。
10.en: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

10.zh: 谨守训诲的，乃在生命的道上； 违弃责备的，便失迷了路。
10.en: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

10.zh: 隐藏怨恨的，有说谎的嘴； 口出谗谤的，是愚妄的人。
10.en: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

10.zh: 多言多语难免有过； 禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
10.en: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

10.zh: 义人的舌乃[似]高银； 恶人的心所值无几。
10.en: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

10.zh: 义人的口教养多人； 愚昧人因无知而死亡。
10.en: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

10.zh: 耶和华所赐的福使人富足， 并不加上忧虑。
10.en: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

10.zh: 愚妄人以行恶为戏耍； 明哲人却以智慧为乐。
10.en: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

10.zh: 恶人所怕的，必临到他； 义人所愿的，必蒙应允。
10.en: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

10.zh: 暴风一过，恶人归于无有； 义人的根基却是永久。
10.en: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

10.zh: 懒惰人叫差他的人 如醋倒牙，如烟薰目。
10.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

10.zh: 敬畏耶和华使人日子加多； 但恶人的年岁必被减少。
10.en: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

10.zh: 义人的盼望[必得]喜乐； 恶人的指望必致灭没。
10.en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

10.zh: 耶和华的道是正直人的保障， 却成了作孽人的败坏。
10.en: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

10.zh: 义人永不挪移； 恶人不得住在地上。
10.en: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

10.zh: 义人的口滋生智慧； 乖谬的舌必被割断。
10.en: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

10.zh: 义人的嘴能令人喜悦； 恶人的口[说]乖谬的话。
10.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

11.zh: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶； 公平的法码为他所喜悦。
11.en: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

11.zh: 骄傲来，羞耻也来； 谦逊人却有智慧。
11.en: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

11.zh: 正直人的纯正必引导自己； 奸诈人的乖僻必毁灭自己。
11.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

11.zh: 发怒的日子资财无益； 惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。
11.en: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

11.zh: 完全人的义必指引他的路； 但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。
11.en: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

11.zh: 正直人的义必拯救自己； 奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
11.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

11.zh: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝； 罪人的盼望也必灭没。
11.en: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

11.zh: 义人得脱离患难， 有恶人来代替他。
11.en: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

11.zh: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍； 义人却因知识得救。
11.en: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

11.zh: 义人享福，合城喜乐； 恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。
11.en: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

11.zh: 城因正直人祝福便高举， 却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。
11.en: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

11.zh: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧； 明哲人却静默不言。
11.en: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

11.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事； 心中诚实的，遮隐事情。
11.en: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

11.zh: 无智谋，民就败落； 谋士多，人便安居。
11.en: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

11.zh: 为外人作保的，必受亏损； 恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。
11.en: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

11.zh: 恩德的妇女得尊荣； 强暴的男子得资财。
11.en: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

11.zh: 仁慈的人善待自己； 残忍的人扰害己身。
11.en: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

11.zh: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价； 撒义种的，得实在的果效。
11.en: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

11.zh: 恒心为义的，[必得]生命； 追求邪恶的，[必致]死亡。
11.en: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

11.zh: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶； 行事完全的，为他所喜悦。
11.en: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

11.zh: 恶人[虽然]连手，必不免受罚； 义人的后裔必得拯救。
11.en: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

11.zh: 妇女美貌而无见识， [如同]金环带在猪鼻上。
11.en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

11.zh: 义人的心愿尽得好处； 恶人的指望致干忿怒。
11.en: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

11.zh: 有施散的，却更增添； 有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。
11.en: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

11.zh: 好施舍的，必得丰裕； 滋润人的，必得滋润。
11.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

11.zh: 屯粮不卖的，民必咒诅他； 情愿出卖的，人必为他祝福。
11.en: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

11.zh: 恳切求善的，就求得恩惠； 惟独求恶的，恶必临到他身。
11.en: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

11.zh: 倚仗自己财物的，必跌倒； 义人必发旺，如青叶。
11.en: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

11.zh: 扰害己家的，必承受清风； 愚昧人必作慧心人的仆人。
11.en: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

11.zh: 义人所结的果子就是生命树； 有智慧的，必能得人。
11.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

11.zh: 看哪，义人在世尚且受报， 何况恶人和罪人呢？
11.en: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

12.zh: 喜爱管教的，就是喜爱知识； 恨恶责备的，却是畜类。
12.en: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

12.zh: 善人必蒙耶和华的恩惠； 设诡计的人，耶和华必定他的罪。
12.en: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

12.zh: 人靠恶行不能坚立； 义人的根必不动摇。
12.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

12.zh: 才德的妇人是丈夫的冠冕； 贻羞的妇人如同朽烂在她丈夫的骨中。
12.en: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

12.zh: 义人的思念是公平； 恶人的计谋是诡诈。
12.en: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

12.zh: 恶人的言论是埋伏流人的血； 正直人的口必拯救人。
12.en: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

12.zh: 恶人倾覆，归于无有； 义人的家必站得住。
12.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

12.zh: 人必按自己的智慧被称赞； 心中乖谬的，必被藐视。
12.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

12.zh: 被人轻贱，却有仆人， 强如自尊，缺少食物。
12.en: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

12.zh: 义人顾惜他牲畜的命； 恶人的怜悯也是残忍。
12.en: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

12.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食； 追随虚浮的，却是无知。
12.en: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

12.zh: 恶人想得坏人的网罗； 义人的根得以结实。
12.en: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

12.zh: 恶人嘴中的过错是自己的网罗； 但义人必脱离患难。
12.en: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

12.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必饱得美福； 人手所做的，必为自己的报应。
12.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

12.zh: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看为正直； 惟智慧人肯听人的劝教。
12.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

12.zh: 愚妄人的恼怒立时显露； 通达人能忍辱藏羞。
12.en: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

12.zh: 说出真话的，显明公义； 作假见证的，显出诡诈。
12.en: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

12.zh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人； 智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。
12.en: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

12.zh: 口吐真言，永远坚立； 舌说谎话，只存片时。
12.en: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

12.zh: 图谋恶事的，心存诡诈； 劝人和睦的，便得喜乐。
12.en: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

12.zh: 义人不遭灾害；恶人满受祸患。
12.en: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

12.zh: 说谎言的嘴为耶和华所憎恶； 行事诚实的，为他所喜悦。
12.en: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

12.zh: 通达人隐藏知识； 愚昧人的心彰显愚昧。
12.en: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

12.zh: 殷勤人的手必掌权； 懒惰的人必服苦。
12.en: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

12.zh: 人心忧虑，屈而不伸； 一句良言，使心欢乐。
12.en: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

12.zh: 义人引导他的邻舍； 恶人的道叫人失迷。
12.en: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

12.zh: 懒惰的人不烤打猎所得的； 殷勤的人却得宝贵的财物。
12.en: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

12.zh: 在公义的道上有生命； 其路之中并无死亡。
12.en: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

13.zh: 智慧子[听]父亲的教训； 亵慢人不听责备。
13.en: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

13.zh: 人因口所结的果子，必享美福； 奸诈人[必遭]强暴。
13.en: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

13.zh: 谨守口的，得保生命； 大张嘴的，必致败亡。
13.en: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

13.zh: 懒惰人羡慕，却无所得； 殷勤人必得丰裕。
13.en: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

13.zh: 义人恨恶谎言； 恶人有臭名，且致惭愧。
13.en: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

13.zh: 行为正直的，有公义保守； 犯罪的，被邪恶倾覆。
13.en: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

13.zh: 假作富足的，却一无所有； 装作穷乏的，却广有财物。
13.en: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

13.zh: 人的资财是他生命的赎价； 穷乏人却听不见威吓的话。
13.en: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

13.zh: 义人的光明亮； 恶人的灯要熄灭。
13.en: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

13.zh: 骄傲只启争竞； 听劝言的，却有智慧。
13.en: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

13.zh: 不劳而得之财必然消耗； 勤劳积蓄的，必见加增。
13.en: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

13.zh: 所盼望的迟延未得，令人心忧； 所愿意的临到，却是生命树。
13.en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

13.zh: 藐视训言的，自取灭亡； 敬畏诫命的，必得善报。
13.en: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

13.zh: 智慧人的法则是生命的泉源， 可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
13.en: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

13.zh: 美好的聪明使人蒙恩； 奸诈人的道路崎岖难行。
13.en: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

13.zh: 凡通达人都凭知识行事； 愚昧人张扬自己的愚昧。
13.en: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

13.zh: 奸恶的使者必陷在祸患里； 忠信的使臣乃医人的良药。
13.en: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

13.zh: 弃绝管教的，[必致]贫受辱； 领受责备的，必得尊荣。
13.en: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

13.zh: 所欲的成就，心觉甘甜； 远离恶事，为愚昧人所憎恶。
13.en: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

13.zh: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 和愚昧人作伴的，必受亏损。
13.en: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

13.zh: 祸患追赶罪人； 义人必得善报。
13.en: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

13.zh: 善人给子孙遗留产业； 罪人为义人积存资财。
13.en: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

13.zh: 穷人耕种多得粮食， 但因不义，有消灭的。
13.en: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

13.zh: 不忍用杖打儿子的，是恨恶他； 疼爱儿子的，随时管教。
13.en: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

13.zh: 义人吃得饱足； 恶人肚腹缺粮。
13.en: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

14.zh: 智慧妇人建立家室； 愚妄妇人亲手拆毁。
14.en: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

14.zh: 行动正直的，敬畏耶和华； 行事乖僻的，却藐视他。
14.en: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

14.zh: 愚妄人口中骄傲，如杖责打己身； 智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
14.en: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

14.zh: 家里无牛，槽头干净； 土产加多乃凭牛力。
14.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

14.zh: 诚实见证人不说谎话； 假见证人吐出谎言。
14.en: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

14.zh: 亵慢人寻智慧，却寻不着； 聪明人易得知识。
14.en: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

14.zh: 到愚昧人面前， 不见他嘴中有知识。
14.en: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

14.zh: 通达人的智慧在乎明白己道； 愚昧人的愚妄乃是诡诈。
14.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

14.zh: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍； 正直人互相喜悦。
14.en: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

14.zh: 心中的苦楚，自己知道； 心里的喜乐，外人无干。
14.en: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

14.zh: 奸恶人的房屋必倾倒； 正直人的帐棚必兴盛。
14.en: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

14.zh: 有一条路，人以为正， 至终成为死亡之路。
14.en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

14.zh: 人在喜笑中，心也忧愁； 快乐至极就生愁苦。
14.en: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

14.zh: 心中背道的，必满得自己的结果； 善人必从自己[的行为得以知足]。
14.en: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

14.zh: 愚蒙人是话都信； 通达人步步谨慎。
14.en: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

14.zh: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事； 愚妄人却狂傲自恃。
14.en: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

14.zh: 轻易发怒的，行事愚妄； 设立诡计的，被人恨恶。
14.en: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

14.zh: 愚蒙人得愚昧为产业； 通达人得知识为冠冕。
14.en: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

14.zh: 坏人俯伏在善人面前； 恶人俯伏在义人门口。
14.en: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

14.zh: 贫穷人连邻舍也恨他； 富足人朋友最多。
14.en: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

14.zh: 藐视邻舍的，这人有罪； 怜悯贫穷的，这人有福。
14.en: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

14.zh: 谋恶的，岂非走入迷途吗？ 谋善的，[必得]慈爱和诚实。
14.en: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

14.zh: 诸般勤劳都有益处； 嘴上多言乃致穷乏。
14.en: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

14.zh: 智慧人的财为自己的冠冕； 愚妄人的愚昧终是愚昧。
14.en: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

14.zh: 作真见证的，救人性命； 吐出谎言的，[施行]诡诈。
14.en: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

14.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，大有倚靠； 他的儿女也有避难所。
14.en: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

14.zh: 敬畏耶和华就是生命的泉源， 可以使人离开死亡的网罗。
14.en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

14.zh: 帝王荣耀在乎民多； 君王衰败在乎民少。
14.en: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

14.zh: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明； 性情暴躁的，大显愚妄。
14.en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

14.zh: 心中安静是肉体的生命； 嫉妒是骨中的朽烂。
14.en: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

14.zh: 欺压贫寒的，是辱没造他的主； 怜悯穷乏的，乃是尊敬主。
14.en: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

14.zh: 恶人在所行的恶上必被推倒； 义人临死，有所投靠。
14.en: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

14.zh: 智慧存在聪明人心中； 愚昧人心里所存的，显而易见。
14.en: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

14.zh: 公义使邦国高举； 罪恶是人民的羞辱。
14.en: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

14.zh: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠； 贻羞的仆人遭其震怒。
14.en: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

15.zh: 回答柔和，使怒消退； 言语暴戾，触动怒气。
15.en: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

15.zh: 智慧人的舌善发知识； 愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
15.en: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

15.zh: 耶和华的眼目无处不在； 恶人善人，他都鉴察。
15.en: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

15.zh: 温良的舌是生命树； 乖谬的嘴使人心碎。
15.en: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

15.zh: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教； 领受责备的，得着见识。
15.en: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

15.zh: 义人家中多有财宝； 恶人得利反受扰害。
15.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

15.zh: 智慧人的嘴播扬知识； 愚昧人的心并不如此。
15.en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

15.zh: 恶人献祭，为耶和华所憎恶； 正直人祈祷，为他所喜悦。
15.en: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

15.zh: 恶人的道路，为耶和华所憎恶； 追求公义的，为他所喜爱。
15.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

15.zh: 舍弃正路的，必受严刑； 恨恶责备的，必致死亡。
15.en: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

15.zh: 阴间和灭亡尚在耶和华眼前， 何况世人的心呢？
15.en: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

15.zh: 亵慢人不爱受责备； 他也不就近智慧人。
15.en: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

15.zh: 心中喜乐，面带笑容； 心里忧愁，灵被损伤。
15.en: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

15.zh: 聪明人心求知识； 愚昧人口吃愚昧。
15.en: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

15.zh: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦； 心中欢畅的，常享丰筵。
15.en: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

15.zh: 少有财宝，敬畏耶和华， 强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。
15.en: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

15.zh: 吃素菜，彼此相爱， 强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
15.en: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

15.zh: 暴怒的人挑启争端； 忍怒的人止息纷争。
15.en: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

15.zh: 懒惰人的道像荆棘的篱笆； 正直人的路是平坦的大道。
15.en: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

15.zh: 智慧子使父亲喜乐； 愚昧人藐视母亲。
15.en: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

15.zh: 无知的人以愚妄为乐； 聪明的人按正直而行。
15.en: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

15.zh: 不先商议，所谋无效； 谋士众多，所谋乃成。
15.en: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

15.zh: 口善应对，自觉喜乐； 话合其时，何等美好。
15.en: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

15.zh: 智慧人从生命的道上升， 使他远离在下的阴间。
15.en: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

15.zh: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家， 却要立定寡妇的地界。
15.en: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

15.zh: 恶谋为耶和华所憎恶； 良言乃为纯净。
15.en: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

15.zh: 贪恋财利的，扰害己家； 恨恶贿赂的，必得存活。
15.en: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

15.zh: 义人的心，思量如何回答； 恶人的口吐出恶言。
15.en: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

15.zh: 耶和华远离恶人， 却听义人的祷告。
15.en: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

15.zh: 眼有光，使心喜乐； 好信息，使骨滋润。
15.en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

15.zh: 听从生命责备的， 必常在智慧人中。
15.en: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

15.zh: 弃绝管教的，轻看自己的生命； 听从责备的，却得智慧。
15.en: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

15.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的训诲； 尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
15.en: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

16.zh: 心中的谋算在乎人； 舌头的应对由于耶和华。
16.en: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

16.zh: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看为清洁； 惟有耶和华衡量人心。
16.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

16.zh: 你所做的，要交托耶和华， 你所谋的，就必成立。
16.en: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

16.zh: 耶和华所造的，各适其用； 就是恶人也为祸患的日子所造。
16.en: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

16.zh: 凡心里骄傲的，为耶和华所憎恶； [虽然]连手，他必不免受罚。
16.en: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

16.zh: 因怜悯诚实，罪孽得赎； 敬畏耶和华的，远离恶事。
16.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

16.zh: 人所行的，若蒙耶和华喜悦， 耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。
16.en: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

16.zh: 多有财利，行事不义， 不如少有财利，行事公义。
16.en: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

16.zh: 人心筹算自己的道路； 惟耶和华指引他的脚步。
16.en: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

16.zh: 王的嘴中有神语， 审判之时，他的口必不差错。
16.en: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

16.zh: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华； 囊中一切法码都为他所定。
16.en: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

16.zh: 作恶，为王所憎恶， 因国位是靠公义坚立。
16.en: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

16.zh: 公义的嘴为王所喜悦； 说正直话的，为王所喜爱。
16.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

16.zh: 王的震怒如杀人的使者； 但智慧人能止息王怒。
16.en: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

16.zh: 王的脸光使人有生命； 王的恩典好像春云时雨。
16.en: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

16.zh: 得智慧胜似得金子； 选聪明强如选银子。
16.en: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

16.zh: 正直人的道是远离恶事； 谨守己路的，是保全性命。
16.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

16.zh: 骄傲在败坏以先； 狂心在跌倒之前。
16.en: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

16.zh: 心里谦卑与穷乏人来往， 强如将掳物与骄傲人同分。
16.en: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

16.zh: 谨守训言的，必得好处； 倚靠耶和华的，便为有福。
16.en: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

16.zh: 心中有智慧，必称为通达人； 嘴中的甜言，加增人的学问。
16.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

16.zh: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源； 愚昧人必被愚昧惩治。
16.en: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

16.zh: 智慧人的心教训他的口， 又使他的嘴增长学问。
16.en: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

16.zh: 良言[如同]蜂房， 使心觉甘甜，使骨得医治。
16.en: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

16.zh: 有一条路，人以为正， 至终成为死亡之路。
16.en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

16.zh: 劳力人的胃口使他劳力， 因为他的口腹催逼他。
16.en: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

16.zh: 匪徒图谋奸恶， 嘴上仿佛有烧焦的火。
16.en: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

16.zh: 乖僻人播散纷争； 传舌的，离间密友。
16.en: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

16.zh: 强暴人诱惑邻舍， 领他走不善之道。
16.en: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

16.zh: 眼目紧合的，图谋乖僻； 嘴唇紧闭的，成就邪恶。
16.en: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

16.zh: 白发是荣耀的冠冕， 在公义的道上必能得着。
16.en: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

16.zh: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士； 治服己心的，强如取城。
16.en: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

16.zh: 签放在怀里， 定事由耶和华。
16.en: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

17.zh: 设筵满屋，大家相争， 不如有块干饼，大家相安。
17.en: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

17.zh: 仆人办事聪明，必管辖贻羞之子， 又在众子中同分产业。
17.en: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

17.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金； 惟有耶和华熬炼人心。
17.en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

17.zh: 行恶的，留心听奸诈之言； 说谎的，侧耳听邪恶之语。
17.en: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

17.zh: 戏笑穷人的，是辱没造他的主； 幸灾乐祸的，必不免受罚。
17.en: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

17.zh: 子孙为老人的冠冕； 父亲是儿女的荣耀。
17.en: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

17.zh: 愚顽人说美言本不相宜， 何况君王说谎话呢？
17.en: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

17.zh: 贿赂在馈送的人眼中看为宝玉， 随处运动都得顺利。
17.en: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

17.zh: 遮掩人过的，寻求人爱； 屡次挑错的，离间密友。
17.en: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

17.zh: 一句责备话深入聪明人的心， 强如责打愚昧人一百下。
17.en: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

17.zh: 恶人只寻背叛， 所以必有严厉的使者奉差攻击他。
17.en: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

17.zh: 宁可遇见丢崽子的母熊， 不可遇见正行愚妄的愚昧人。
17.en: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

17.zh: 以恶报善的， 祸患必不离他的家。
17.en: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

17.zh: 纷争的起头[如]水放开， 所以，在争闹之先必当止息争竞。
17.en: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

17.zh: 定恶人为义的，定义人为恶的， 这都为耶和华所憎恶。
17.en: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

17.zh: 愚昧人既无聪明， 为何手拿价银买智慧呢？
17.en: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

17.zh: 朋友乃时常亲爱， 弟兄为患难而生。
17.en: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

17.zh: 在邻舍面前击掌作保 乃是无知的人。
17.en: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

17.zh: 喜爱争竞的，是喜爱过犯； 高立家门的，乃自取败坏。
17.en: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

17.zh: 心存邪僻的，寻不着好处； 舌弄是非的，陷在祸患中。
17.en: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

17.zh: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦； 愚顽人的父毫无喜乐。
17.en: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

17.zh: 喜乐的心乃是良药； 忧伤的灵使骨枯干。
17.en: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

17.zh: 恶人暗中受贿赂， 为要颠倒判断。
17.en: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

17.zh: 明哲人眼前有智慧； 愚昧人眼望地极。
17.en: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

17.zh: 愚昧子使父亲愁烦， 使母亲忧苦。
17.en: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

17.zh: 刑罚义人为不善； 责打君子为不义。
17.en: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

17.zh: 寡少言语的，有知识； 性情温良的，有聪明。
17.en: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

17.zh: 愚昧人若静默不言也可算为智慧； 闭口不说也可算为聪明。
17.en: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

18.zh: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿， 并恼恨一切真智慧。
18.en: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

18.zh: 愚昧人不喜爱明哲， 只喜爱显露心意。
18.en: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

18.zh: 恶人来，藐视随来； 羞耻到，辱骂同到。
18.en: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

18.zh: 人口中的言语如同深水； 智慧的泉源好像涌流的河水。
18.en: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

18.zh: 瞻徇恶人的情面， 偏断义人的案件，都为不善。
18.en: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

18.zh: 愚昧人张嘴启争端， 开口招鞭打。
18.en: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

18.zh: 愚昧人的口自取败坏； 他的嘴是他生命的网罗。
18.en: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

18.zh: 传舌人的言语如同美食， 深入人的心腹。
18.en: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

18.zh: 做工懈怠的， 与浪费人为弟兄。
18.en: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

18.zh: 耶和华的名是坚固台； 义人奔入便得安稳。
18.en: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

18.zh: 富足人的财物是他的坚城， 在他心想，犹如高墙。
18.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

18.zh: 败坏之先，人心骄傲； 尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
18.en: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

18.zh: 未曾听完先回答的， 便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
18.en: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

18.zh: 人有疾病，心能忍耐； 心灵忧伤，谁能承当呢？
18.en: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

18.zh: 聪明人的心得知识； 智慧人的耳求知识。
18.en: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

18.zh: 人的礼物为他开路， 引他到高位的人面前。
18.en: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

18.zh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理； 但邻舍来到，就察出实情。
18.en: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

18.zh: 掣签能止息争竞， 也能解散强胜的人。
18.en: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

18.zh: 弟兄结怨，[劝他和好]，比取坚固城还难； [这样的]争竞如同坚寨的门闩。
18.en: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

18.zh: 人口中所结的果子，必充满肚腹； 他嘴所出的，必使他饱足。
18.en: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

18.zh: 生死在舌头的权下， 喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。
18.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

18.zh: 得着[贤]妻的，是得着好处， 也是蒙了耶和华的恩惠。
18.en: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

18.zh: 贫穷人说哀求的话； 富足人用威吓的话回答。
18.en: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

18.zh: 滥交朋友的，自取败坏； 但有一朋友比弟兄更亲密。
18.en: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

19.zh: 行为纯正的贫穷人 胜过乖谬愚妄的[富足]人。
19.en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

19.zh: 心无知识的，乃为不善； 脚步急快的，难免犯罪。
19.en: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

19.zh: 人的愚昧倾败他的道； 他的心也抱怨耶和华。
19.en: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

19.zh: 财物使朋友增多； 但穷人朋友远离。
19.en: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

19.zh: 作假见证的，必不免受罚； 吐出谎言的，终不能逃脱。
19.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

19.zh: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情； 爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。
19.en: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

19.zh: 贫穷人，弟兄都恨他； 何况他的朋友，更远离他！ 他用言语追随，他们却走了。
19.en: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

19.zh: 得着智慧的，爱惜生命； 保守聪明的，必得好处。
19.en: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

19.zh: 作假见证的，不免受罚； 吐出谎言的，也必灭亡。
19.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

19.zh: 愚昧人宴乐度日是不合宜的； 何况仆人管辖王子呢？
19.en: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

19.zh: 人有见识就不轻易发怒； 宽恕人的过失便是自己的荣耀。
19.en: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

19.zh: 王的忿怒好像狮子吼叫； 他的恩典却如草上的甘露。
19.en: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

19.zh: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患； 妻子的争吵[如雨]连连滴漏。
19.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

19.zh: 房屋钱财是祖宗所遗留的； 惟有贤慧的妻是耶和华所赐的。
19.en: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

19.zh: 懒惰使人沉睡； 懈怠的人必受饥饿。
19.en: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

19.zh: 谨守诫命的，保全生命； 轻忽己路的，必致死亡。
19.en: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

19.zh: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给耶和华； 他的善行，耶和华必偿还。
19.en: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

19.zh: 趁有指望，管教你的儿子； 你的心不可任他死亡。
19.en: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

19.zh: 暴怒的人必受刑罚； 你若救他，必须再救。
19.en: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

19.zh: 你要听劝教，受训诲， 使你终久有智慧。
19.en: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

19.zh: 人心多有计谋； 惟有耶和华的筹算才能立定。
19.en: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

19.zh: 施行仁慈的，令人爱慕； 穷人强如说谎言的。
19.en: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

19.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，[得着]生命； 他必恒久知足，不遭祸患。
19.en: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

19.zh: 懒惰人放手在盘子里， 就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
19.en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

19.zh: 鞭打亵慢人，愚蒙人必长见识； 责备明哲人，他就明白知识。
19.en: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

19.zh: 虐待父亲、撵出母亲的， 是贻羞致辱之子。
19.en: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

19.zh: 我儿，不可听了教训 而又偏离知识的言语。
19.en: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

19.zh: 匪徒作见证戏笑公平； 恶人的口吞下罪孽。
19.en: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

19.zh: 刑罚是为亵慢人预备的； 鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。
19.en: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

20.zh: 酒能使人亵慢，浓酒使人喧嚷； 凡因酒错误的，就无智慧。
20.en: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

20.zh: 王的威吓如同狮子吼叫； 惹动他怒的，是自害己命。
20.en: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

20.zh: 远离纷争是人的尊荣； 愚妄人都爱争闹。
20.en: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

20.zh: 懒惰人因冬寒不肯耕种， 到收割的时候，他必讨饭而无所得。
20.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

20.zh: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水， 惟明哲人才能汲引出来。
20.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

20.zh: 人多述说自己的仁慈， 但忠信人谁能遇着呢？
20.en: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

20.zh: 行为纯正的义人， 他的子孙是有福的！
20.en: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

20.zh: 王坐在审判的位上， 以眼目驱散诸恶。
20.en: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

20.zh: 谁能说，我洁净了我的心， 我脱净了我的罪？
20.en: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

20.zh: 两样的法码，两样的升斗， 都为耶和华所憎恶。
20.en: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

20.zh: 孩童的动作是清洁，是正直， 都显明他的本性。
20.en: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

20.zh: 能听的耳，能看的眼， 都是耶和华所造的。
20.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

20.zh: 不要贪睡，免致贫穷； 眼要睁开，你就吃饱。
20.en: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

20.zh: 买物的说：不好，不好； 及至[买]去，他便自夸。
20.en: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

20.zh: 有金子和许多珍珠， 惟有知识的嘴乃为贵重的珍宝。
20.en: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

20.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服； 谁为外人[作保]，谁就要承当。
20.en: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

20.zh: 以虚谎而得的食物，人觉甘甜； 但后来，他的口必充满尘沙。
20.en: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

20.zh: 计谋都凭筹算立定； 打仗要凭智谋。
20.en: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

20.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事； 大张嘴的，不可与他结交。
20.en: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

20.zh: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必灭， 变为漆黑的黑暗。
20.en: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

20.zh: 起初速得的产业， 终久却不为福。
20.en: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

20.zh: 你不要说，我要以恶报恶； 要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。
20.en: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

20.zh: 两样的法码为耶和华所憎恶； 诡诈的天平也为不善。
20.en: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

20.zh: 人的脚步为耶和华所定； 人岂能明白自己的路呢？
20.en: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

20.zh: 人冒失说，[这是]圣物， 许愿之后才查问，就是自陷网罗。
20.en: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

20.zh: 智慧的王簸散恶人， 用碌碡滚轧他们。
20.en: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

20.zh: 人的灵是耶和华的灯， 鉴察人的心腹。
20.en: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

20.zh: 王因仁慈和诚实得以保全他的国位， 也因仁慈立稳。
20.en: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

20.zh: 强壮乃少年人的荣耀； 白发为老年人的尊荣。
20.en: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

20.zh: 鞭伤除净人的罪恶； 责打[能入]人的心腹。
20.en: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

21.zh: 王的心在耶和华手中， 好像陇沟的水随意流转。
21.en: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

21.zh: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看为正； 惟有耶和华衡量人心。
21.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

21.zh: 行仁义公平 比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。
21.en: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

21.zh: 恶人发达，眼高心傲， 这乃是罪。
21.en: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

21.zh: 殷勤筹划的，足致丰裕； 行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
21.en: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

21.zh: 用诡诈之舌求财的，就是自己取死； 所得之财乃是吹来吹去的浮云。
21.en: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

21.zh: 恶人的强暴必将自己扫除， 因他们不肯按公平行事。
21.en: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

21.zh: 负罪之人的路甚是弯曲； 至于清洁的人，他所行的乃是正直。
21.en: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

21.zh: 宁可住在房顶的角上， 不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。
21.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

21.zh: 恶人的心乐人受祸； 他眼并不怜恤邻舍。
21.en: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

21.zh: 亵慢的人受刑罚，愚蒙的人就得智慧； 智慧人受训诲，便得知识。
21.en: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

21.zh: 义人思想恶人的家， 知道恶人倾倒，必致灭亡。
21.en: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

21.zh: 塞耳不听穷人哀求的， 他将来呼吁也不蒙应允。
21.en: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

21.zh: 暗中送的礼物挽回怒气； 怀中搋的贿赂止息暴怒。
21.en: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

21.zh: 秉公行义使义人喜乐， 使作孽的人败坏。
21.en: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

21.zh: 迷离通达道路的， 必住在阴魂的会中。
21.en: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

21.zh: 爱宴乐的，必致穷乏； 好酒，爱膏油的，必不富足。
21.en: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

21.zh: 恶人作了义人的赎价； 奸诈人代替正直人。
21.en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

21.zh: 宁可住在旷野， 不与争吵使气的妇人同住。
21.en: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

21.zh: 智慧人家中[积蓄]宝物膏油； 愚昧人随得来随吞下。
21.en: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

21.zh: 追求公义仁慈的， 就寻得生命、公义，和尊荣。
21.en: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

21.zh: 智慧人爬上勇士的城墙， 倾覆他所倚靠的坚垒。
21.en: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

21.zh: 谨守口与舌的， 就保守自己免受灾难。
21.en: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

21.zh: 心骄气傲的人名叫亵慢； 他行事狂妄，都出于骄傲。
21.en: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

21.zh: 懒惰人的心愿将他杀害， 因为他手不肯做工。
21.en: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

21.zh: 有终日贪得无厌的； 义人施舍而不吝惜。
21.en: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

21.zh: 恶人的祭物是可憎的； 何况他存恶意来献呢？
21.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

21.zh: 作假见证的必灭亡； 惟有听真情而言的，其言长存。
21.en: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

21.zh: 恶人脸无羞耻； 正直人行事坚定。
21.en: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

21.zh: 没有人能以智慧、聪明、 谋略敌挡耶和华。
21.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

21.zh: 马是为打仗之日预备的； 得胜乃在乎耶和华。
21.en: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

22.zh: 美名胜过大财； 恩宠强如金银。
22.en: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

22.zh: 富户穷人在世相遇， 都为耶和华所造。
22.en: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.

22.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲； 愚蒙人前往受害。
22.en: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

22.zh: 敬畏耶和华心存谦卑， 就得富有、尊荣、生命为赏赐。
22.en: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

22.zh: 乖僻人的路上有荆棘和网罗； 保守自己生命的，必要远离。
22.en: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

22.zh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道， 就是到老他也不偏离。
22.en: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

22.zh: 富户管辖穷人； 欠债的是债主的仆人。
22.en: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

22.zh: 撒罪孽的，必收灾祸； 他逞怒的杖也必废掉。
22.en: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

22.zh: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福， 因他将食物分给穷人。
22.en: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

22.zh: 赶出亵慢人，争端就消除； 纷争和羞辱也必止息。
22.en: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

22.zh: 喜爱清心的人因他嘴上的恩言， 王必与他为友。
22.en: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

22.zh: 耶和华的眼目眷顾聪明人， 却倾败奸诈人的言语。
22.en: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

22.zh: 懒惰人说：外头有狮子； 我在街上就必被杀。
22.en: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

22.zh: 淫妇的口为深坑； 耶和华所憎恶的，必陷在其中。
22.en: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.

22.zh: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心， 用管教的杖可以远远赶除。
22.en: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

22.zh: 欺压贫穷为要利己的， 并送[礼]与富户的，都必缺乏。
22.en: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

22.zh: 你须侧耳听受智慧人的言语， 留心领会我的知识。
22.en: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

22.zh: 你若心中存记， 嘴上咬定，这便为美。
22.en: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

22.zh: 我今日以此特特指教你， 为要使你倚靠耶和华。
22.en: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.

22.zh: 谋略和知识的美事， 我岂没有写给你吗？
22.en: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

22.zh: 要使你知道真言的实理， 你好将真言回复那打发你来的人。
22.en: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

22.zh: 贫穷人，你不可因他贫穷就抢夺他的物， 也不可在城门口欺压困苦人；
22.en: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

22.zh: 因耶和华必为他辨屈； 抢夺他的，耶和华必夺取那人的命。
22.en: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

22.zh: 好生气的人，不可与他结交； 暴怒的人，不可与他来往；
22.en: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

22.zh: 恐怕你效法他的行为， 自己就陷在网罗里。
22.en: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

22.zh: 不要与人击掌， 不要为欠债的作保。
22.en: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

22.zh: 你若没有什么偿还， 何必使人夺去你睡卧的床呢？
22.en: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

22.zh: 你先祖所立的地界， 你不可挪移。
22.en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

22.zh: 你看见办事殷勤的人吗？ 他必站在君王面前， 必不站在下贱人面前。
22.en: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

23.zh: 你若与官长坐席， 要留意在你面前的是谁。
23.en: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

23.zh: 你若是贪食的， 就当拿刀放在喉咙上。
23.en: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

23.zh: 不可贪恋他的美食， 因为是哄人的食物。
23.en: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

23.zh: 不要劳碌求富， 休仗自己的聪明。
23.en: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

23.zh: 你岂要定睛在虚无的[钱财]上吗？ 因[钱财]必长翅膀，如鹰向天飞去。
23.en: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

23.zh: 不要吃恶眼人的饭， 也不要贪他的美味；
23.en: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

23.zh: 因为他心怎样思量， 他为人就是怎样。 他虽对你说，请吃，请喝， 他的心却与你相背。
23.en: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

23.zh: 你所吃的那点食物必吐出来； 你所说的甘美言语也必落空。
23.en: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

23.zh: 你不要说话给愚昧人听， 因他必藐视你智慧的言语。
23.en: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

23.zh: 不可挪移古时的地界， 也不可侵入孤儿的田地；
23.en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

23.zh: 因他们的救赎主大有能力， 他必向你为他们辨屈。
23.en: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

23.zh: 你要留心领受训诲， 侧耳听从知识的言语。
23.en: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

23.zh: 不可不管教孩童； 你用杖打他，他必不至于死。
23.en: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

23.zh: 你要用杖打他， 就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
23.en: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

23.zh: 我儿，你心若存智慧， 我的心也甚欢喜。
23.en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

23.zh: 你的嘴若说正直话， 我的心肠也必快乐。
23.en: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

23.zh: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人， 只要终日敬畏耶和华；
23.en: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

23.zh: 因为至终必有善报， 你的指望也不致断绝。
23.en: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

23.zh: 我儿，你当听，当存智慧， 好在正道上引导你的心。
23.en: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

23.zh: 好饮酒的，好吃肉的， 不要与他们来往；
